title: Own the cloud half of [A4] post-merge: ticfac run <epic> --cloud
body:
A4's cloud run cannot execute before the close-out merge: the factory deploys main only, and main (c7e11fe3 at 2026-10-05) is strictly behind epic/43y — the epic merges to main only at close-out, which the final review gates, and the review is blocked-by qdg itself. It also needs twa (open) to flip .tick/runners.cloud.toml to kind pi-durable — today a cloud dispatch of this repo boots every container into 'unknown harness kind pi' — and, for a hn6-style run of this repository, dm6 (open) for the factory-side forge access the PR rule requires. Runbook for whoever owns it: merge epic/43y to main at close-out; ticfac factory wait-deployed <merge sha>; land twa; land dm6; then ticfac run hn6 --cloud (hn6 is the operator's named candidate) or the next feasible epic — every worker then boots a factory sandbox container on pi-durable, and A4's cloud half is observed. Without an owner, A4 closes at best predicted.
evidence: AGENTS.md (deploy-factory deploys main only); git merge-base origin/main epic/43y on 2026-10-05 (main strictly behind); .tick/issues/twa.json open; .tick/issues/dm6.json open; .tick/issues/hn6.json 'Candidate: the first epic run in the cloud once dm6 lands'
